Based on my search, I can provide you with comprehensive information about **CFA Institute membership** and related fees for 2026.

## CFA Institute Membership Overview

The CFA Institute is the global body that administers the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) program. To earn and use the CFA charter, you must become a **Regular Member** of the CFA Institute.

### Types of Membership

| Membership Type | Requirements | Benefits |
|----------------|------------|----------|
| **Regular Membership** | Pass Level I CFA Exam + 4,000 hours of relevant work experience over 36 months + 2-3 professional references | Voting rights, access to research, member directory, volunteer opportunities, **required for CFA charter** |
| **Affiliate Membership** | Pass Level I CFA Exam (no work experience required) | Access to research, continued learning content, member directory, volunteer opportunities |

## 2026 CFA Institute Membership Fees

### Annual Dues
- **CFA Institute Global Dues:** **USD $299/year** (required to maintain active charterholder status)
- **CFA Institute Dues for India members:** **USD $159/year** (discounted rate for certain countries including India)

### CFA Society India Dues
- **Regular & Affiliate Membership:** INR 5,000 + 18% GST
- **Professional Leave:** INR 2,000 + 18% GST
- **Membership year:** July 1 – June 30

> **Important:** CFA Society India now collects membership dues in **local currency (INR)**.

## Major 2026 Fee Change: Enrollment Fee Abolished

Starting from February 2026 exams:
- **One-time enrollment fee of USD $350 has been ELIMINATED**
- This reduces the barrier for new candidates entering the program

## Complete CFA Program Cost Breakdown (2026)

| Component | Cost (USD) |
|-----------|-----------|
| Level I Exam (Early/Standard) | $1,140 / $1,490 |
| Level II Exam (Early/Standard) | $1,140 / $1,490 |
| Level III Exam (Early/Standard) | $1,240 / $1,590 |
| Rescheduling Fee | $250 |
| **Total for all 3 levels (early registration, first attempt)** | **~$3,520** |
| **Total for all 3 levels (standard registration, first attempt)** | **~$4,570** |
| Annual membership dues (post-charter) | $299/year |

## Requirements to Become a CFA Charterholder

1. **Pass all 3 CFA exam levels** (Level I, II, and III)
2. **Accumulate 4,000 hours** of qualified work experience over at least 36 months
3. **Provide 2-3 professional references** (2 if one is an active regular member of your local CFA society; 3 otherwise)
4. **Sign the Ethics pledge**
5. **Apply for CFA Institute membership** (including local society membership)

### Work Experience Details
- Must involve evaluating or applying financial, economic, and/or statistical data in the **investment decision-making process**
- Can be accumulated **before, during, or after** passing the exams
- Corporate finance, back-office operations, and basic accounting typically **do not qualify**

## Key Points to Remember

- You can only use the "CFA" designation if you maintain **active Regular Membership**
- If membership lapses due to non-payment of dues, you lose the right to use the CFA designation (but can reactivate by paying back dues)
- Joining a **local CFA society is required** for CFA Institute membership application
- Membership applications take up to **10 business days** for CFA Institute review, plus up to **1 month** for local society review

Sources:
1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://quintedge.com/blog/cfa-course-fee
6. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
7. https://rbeiset.com/cfa-course-2026-eligibility-fees-syllabus-career-scope/
8. https://proschoolonline.com/blog/cfa-enrollment-fees-update
